_about: ARC-09-C263 stage 0 (P0) captures of Claude Code session transcripts (the file transcript_path names), one set per version: the floor 2.1.214, the measured 2.1.309 and the current 2.1.318. Sanitised BY KEY: accountUuid, organizationUuid and userEmail are replaced by registered placeholders whatever their value; every string has the home directory, the user name, the account e-mail and the scratch paths rewritten; system-prompt bulk and thinking signatures are replaced. tests/transcript-fixtures-identity.test.mjs holds this. Kept as captured: row types, flags, order, and the session, request and tool-use ids and content digests (correlation ids, not account data). A hook probe, not the product, ran in the capturing session. The Windows (CRLF, back-slash) variants are derived from these by the tests and are synthetic.
